Research Experience

KUDoc: Korea University Document AI Research Group

2024 - Present | Seoul, Republic of Korea

Founder & Lead

  • Founding & research agenda: Built the group from the ground up as an independent line of document AI work at Korea University.
  • Project coordination: Oversaw KUDoc-affiliated projects that produced 15 publications, 3 technology transfers, and multiple industry collaborations.
  • Technical direction: Steered research across multimodal document parsing, structure-aware retrieval, grounded document QA, and agentic systems.

Related: KUDoc site · DocGraph Copilot · Synapse

Human-Inspired AI Research Institute, Korea University

Jun 2023 - Present | Seoul, Republic of Korea

Senior Researcher

  • Structure-grounded multimodal reasoning: Developed retrieval and reasoning methods that preserve document structure — layout, tables, figures, and cross-page dependencies — turning noisy multi-page documents and video into grounded evidence for QA.
  • First-author work: Led first-author papers at NeurIPS, EMNLP, ACL, and CVPR on agent memory-write admission, page-grounded evidence graphs, hierarchical retrieval, multimodal document dependency parsing, and structure-preserving chunking.
  • Hybrid reasoning systems: Built QA pipelines combining LLMs/LVLMs, knowledge graphs, symbolic rules, and evidence filtering for accurate, interpretable answers.
  • Applied validation: Validated multimodal RAG in insurance, manufacturing, and healthcare, including a Samsung Fire & Marine MVP that cut manual document search time by about 40%.

Related: ADMIT · PILAR · HiKEY · M3DocDep · MultiDocFusion · StyleDFS · Synerpeace

AI Lab, Pusan National University

Sep 2020 - Feb 2023 | Busan, Republic of Korea

Graduate Researcher

  • Korean dependency parsing: Developed neural-symbolic dependency parsing methods that integrate morphological and syntactic information for robust Korean language understanding.
  • Table and document QA: Designed pipelines that convert semi-structured tables and documents into structured representations for question answering and interpretable reasoning.
  • Applied collaborations: Contributed to Korean TTS prosody prediction with KT AI2XL and additional projects in finance QA, sentiment-based marketing, and recommendation systems.

Related: Master’s Thesis · Hybrid Reader over Tables and Text · Exobrain WiseQA
